kinds.name: Acorn
kinds.entry: Off the outside of the Volute, a barnacle. Lived on your world its whole life and never once looked in. Two cowries, no questions.

abilities.name: Cirri Fire
abilities.text: Hits 3 times for 36% ATK. +10% per use since it came out, up to +30%.

abilities.name: Cement Spear
abilities.text: Hits for 100% ATK. Stun 1 if it can't switch, else delays it 30%.

abilities.name: Shut Tight
abilities.text: Unstoppable 2. Fortify 2 at 35%.

abilities.name: Barnacle Bed
abilities.text: Unstoppable wind-up. Hits every foe for 150% ATK. Stun 1.

abilities.name: Cemented
abilities.text: Cannot be forced out or dragged in. Takes 0.9x damage from attacks.

abilities.name: Spat Spin
abilities.text: When it comes out: blocks the first projectile move aimed at it.

kinds.name: Columba
kinds.entry: One of the five doves out of a sand dollar. Flies only at night and brings things back. Four cowries, or whatever it brought you.

abilities.name: Dove Wing
abilities.text: Heals an ally 12% of max HP + 10% CHA.

abilities.name: Carry Light
abilities.text: An ally gets Empower 2. Hits the foe for 50% MGK.

abilities.name: Fly Home
abilities.text: Switches to an ally. It heals 10% of max HP and acts at once.

abilities.name: Ring Home
abilities.text: Brings back your first KO'd whorl at 15% HP. If none: team heals 15%.

abilities.name: Doves
abilities.text: Turn start: if nothing hit it since its last turn, heals 5% of max HP.

abilities.name: Homing
abilities.text: When it comes out: its first turn comes 30% sooner.

kinds.name: Bollard
kinds.entry: And a white post, off the corner of a slot in the Tray. Stands where it's put and nowhere else. Four cowries, so put it somewhere good.

abilities.name: Post Shot
abilities.text: Hits for 110% ATK.

abilities.name: Shove Back
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 75% ATK. Weaken 1.

abilities.name: Post Drive
abilities.text: Drives itself in, or pulls out. Driven In: 1.2x DEF, 0.85x AGI.

abilities.name: Four Posts
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 40% ATK. Next 3 turns: 60% ATK to every foe.

abilities.name: Stands Put
abilities.text: Cannot be forced out. Driven In: takes 0.8x damage, can't switch.

abilities.name: Corner Post
abilities.text: Turn start, Driven In: heals 6% of its max HP.

kinds.name: Menhir
kinds.entry: Which is a standing stone's cast. Stands. Stood before the Stays went in. Five cowries, and I'd not ask it to sit.

abilities.name: Wind Shadow
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 42% MGK + 42% DEF.

abilities.name: Stand Fast
abilities.text: Taunt 1. Fortify 2 on itself.

abilities.name: Shoulder In
abilities.text: Hits for 75% ATK + 45% DEF. Stun 1.

abilities.name: Keel Over
abilities.text: Unstoppable wind-up. Hits every foe for 145% ATK. Stun 1. Fortify 2.

abilities.name: Old Stance
abilities.text: Every 3rd turn: its attack adds 50% DEF and hits reserves. Taunts last +1 turn.

abilities.name: Heavy Base
abilities.text: Its moves add 30% DEF to their damage. Takes 0.85x magic damage.

kinds.name: Wain
kinds.entry: Off a hay cart. Starts slow and doesn't stop. Went through the grotto wall once. Four cowries, plus the wall.

abilities.name: Run Over
abilities.text: Hits for 115% ATK. Slow 1.

abilities.name: Into the Rut
abilities.text: Wind-up. Hits for 120% ATK. Stun 1.

abilities.name: Chock Wheels
abilities.text: 15% max HP shield, 2 turns. If it lasts: foe takes 10% of its max HP.

abilities.name: Runaway Cart
abilities.text: Unstoppable wind-up. Hits for 170% ATK. Stun 1.

abilities.name: Keeps Rolling
abilities.text: Once, at 0 HP: a Wreck at 40% HP, 1.3x ATK. Attacks only. Loses 20% max HP a turn.

abilities.name: Heavier Load
abilities.text: When a foe is KO'd while it is out: +6% max HP for the battle.

kinds.name: Coma
kinds.entry: The head of a comet. Comes round once a lifetime and here it is in my shop. Six cowries, once in a lifetime.

abilities.name: Dust Tail
abilities.text: Hits for 110% MGK. Slow 1. Its next turn comes 15% sooner.

abilities.name: Frozen Core
abilities.text: For 3 turns: attacks add 30% DEF, reserves take 30% MGK. Fortify 1.

abilities.name: Tail Sweep
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 50% MGK + 40% DEF. Weaken 2.

abilities.name: Strike Home
abilities.text: Unstoppable wind-up. Hits every foe for 140% MGK. Stun 1.

abilities.name: Ice Crust
abilities.text: Starts with a shield of 10% max HP. It refills after 2 turns unhit.

abilities.name: Sunward
abilities.text: When it comes out: its first move is Unstoppable and deals 1.3x.

kinds.name: Rung
kinds.entry: Plus a rung off a ladder on the Climb. Every turn it takes, it's a step higher. Six cowries on the bottom step.

abilities.name: Rung Rap
abilities.text: Hits for 95% MGK, +5% per Step. Slow 1.

abilities.name: Crossbar
abilities.text: Hits for 80% MGK. Reserve behind: Stun 1, it takes 50%. Else Slow 2.

abilities.name: Landing Rest
abilities.text: Sets a Landing (8% max HP).

abilities.name: Stand Still
abilities.text: Stasis 1 on the foe. Your next ally out comes 60% sooner. Heals 10%.

abilities.name: Step Higher
abilities.text: Turn start: +1 Step, up to 6. Its attacks add 8% MGK per Step.

abilities.name: Sure Footing
abilities.text: Its switches take 30% of a turn.

kinds.name: Porcella
kinds.entry: Pig! Small, round, glazed all over, kept by the Cowrie folk. Rolls when the floor tilts, and the floor tilts. Two cowries. You chase it.

abilities.name: Snort
abilities.text: Hits for 120% ATK. Heals 15% of it. Foe summons take 40% ATK.

abilities.name: Start Rolling
abilities.text: Unstoppable wind-up. Hits for 130% ATK. Stun 1.

abilities.name: Bump
abilities.text: Hits 3 times for 35% ATK. All 3 land: Root 1.

abilities.name: Downhill
abilities.text: Long wind-up. Hits every foe for 170% ATK. Slow 2.

abilities.name: Glaze Shell
abilities.text: Takes 0.8x damage while it has a wind-up coming.

abilities.name: Tilts
abilities.text: When it comes out: its first turn comes 30% sooner, its first attack deals 1.2x.

kinds.name: Astrolabe
kinds.entry: The Tide-reader's grandmother's brass star-measurer. Kept measuring after she stopped. Six cowries. It measured me. I'm short.

abilities.name: Sight Line
abilities.text: Hits for 100% MGK. Counts as 2 hits toward Measuring.

abilities.name: Brass Ring
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 60% MGK. Slow 2. Its next turn comes 30% sooner.

abilities.name: Star Shower
abilities.text: Hits for 40% MGK. Next 3 turns: 30% MGK and Slow 1 on the foe.

abilities.name: Last Reading
abilities.text: Unstoppable long wind-up. Hits for 210% MGK.

abilities.name: Measuring
abilities.text: Every 4th hit it lands deals 1.6x and delays the foe's next turn by 20%.

abilities.name: Long Sight
abilities.text: Deals 1.25x damage to a foe winding up.

kinds.name: Buckler
kinds.entry: A round shield, one eye where the boss should be. Counts the blows it takes and pays each one back. Four cowries. Honest, that.

abilities.name: Rim Throw
abilities.text: Hits for 115% ATK. 1.5x on a foe below 25% HP.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.text: Hits for 95% ATK. Stun 1.

abilities.name: Raise the Rim
abilities.text: Attacks deal it 0 until its next turn. Then every foe takes 80% ATK.

abilities.name: Falling Shield
abilities.text: Unstoppable wind-up. Hits every foe for 150% ATK. Slow 2.

abilities.name: Fourth Blow
abilities.text: Every 4th move deals 1.5x damage.

abilities.name: Pay Back
abilities.text: Each attack Raise the Rim stops is answered for 40% ATK.

kinds.name: Stump
kinds.entry: What was left when somebody cut the tree. Grows a ring a year anyway. Two cowries now. A cowrie more each ring.

abilities.name: Splinter Off
abilities.text: Hits for 105% ATK + 8% of the foe's current HP. Slow 1.

abilities.name: Sap Rising
abilities.text: Hits for 50% ATK. After 2 turns: heals 40% of damage taken in them.

abilities.name: Stump Butt
abilities.text: Hits for 90% ATK + 25% of its missing HP. Unstoppable 1.

abilities.name: New Growth
abilities.text: Max HP +15% for the battle. Regen 3. Haste 2.

abilities.name: Year Rings
abilities.text: Turn start: grows a Ring, up to 4. Each Ring adds 2% max HP.

abilities.name: Sucker Shoots
abilities.text: The first Stun, Sleep, or Root each time it comes out is removed. Heals 5% max HP.

kinds.name: Turbine
kinds.entry: And this one faces the wind and makes wind for its friends. Hold your three cowries tight when you pay.

abilities.name: Vane Cut
abilities.text: Hits for 110% MGK. Slow 1.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.text: Wind-up. Hits for 100% MGK. Stun 1.

abilities.name: Lee Side
abilities.text: Shields an ally for 50% CHA + 6% of its max HP, 3 turns. Empower 2.

abilities.name: Onshore Wind
abilities.text: Your team heals 20% max HP, now and next turn. Forces the foe out.

abilities.name: Sea Breeze
abilities.text: In reserve: your out whorl gets +5 AGI and deals 1.05x damage.

abilities.name: Light Vanes
abilities.text: Immune to Slow and to delays.

kinds.name: Siderite
kinds.entry: An iron stone off the fallen star. Walk past it and your buckles try to stay. Five cowries, and whatever buckles it keeps.

abilities.name: Iron Wave
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 68% ATK. Slow 1.

abilities.name: Pull Iron
abilities.text: Drags in a reserve. Hits it for 90% ATK. Slow 2.

abilities.name: Lend Pull
abilities.text: An ally: Empower 2. 3 turns: its attacks hit reserves for 30% ATK.

abilities.name: Turn Poles
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 110% ATK, +10% per foe reserve. Stun 2.

abilities.name: Pull Through
abilities.text: When it Stuns a foe: each foe reserve takes 20% ATK.

abilities.name: Too Heavy
abilities.text: Cannot be forced out or dragged in. Ignores delays.

kinds.name: Belt
kinds.entry: Which carries whatever stands on it to the same place, same speed. A conveyor belt's shell. Three cowries, same price.

abilities.name: Roller Spin
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 72% MGK.

abilities.name: Couple Up
abilities.text: Couples an ally. Both heal 10% of max HP. Slow 1 on the foe.

abilities.name: Belt Speed
abilities.text: Haste 2 and Fortify 1 on it and its Coupled ally. Pays 6% max HP.

abilities.name: Carry Over
abilities.text: Couples an ally and switches to it: heals 15%, acts at once.

abilities.name: Same Load
abilities.text: Its heals also heal its Coupled ally for 50%.

abilities.name: Idler Wheel
abilities.text: Coupled ally: first turn 30% sooner. In reserve: it takes 0.88x damage.

kinds.name: Skua
kinds.entry: And a skua, second beak in its belly. Follows one of yours and gets paid when it drops. Three cowries. We're in the same trade.

abilities.name: Harry
abilities.text: Hits for 110% ATK. A Followed reserve takes 60% of the damage.

abilities.name: Stoop
abilities.text: Its next attack deals 1.8x damage. Steals 1 tide.

abilities.name: Follow
abilities.text: Expose 1. The foe is Followed for the battle.

abilities.name: Out of the Sun
abilities.text: Hidden 2. Its next attack deals 2x damage.

abilities.name: High Wheel
abilities.text: When it comes out or guards: its next attack deals 1.5x and adds Slow 1.

abilities.name: Robber
abilities.text: Deals 1.2x to Followed foes. When a Followed foe is KO'd: 3 tide.

kinds.name: Lodestar
kinds.entry: The star the Gleaner walked by. Took it down and kept it. Still points the same way. Seven cowries. Don't ask it the way home.

abilities.name: Bearing
abilities.text: Hits for 110% MGK. Spends a Fixed Star: delays the foe's turn by 30%.

abilities.name: Star Fix

abilities.name: Steer By
abilities.text: Hits for 85% MGK. Expose 2. A Fixed Star spent: can't switch 2 turns.

abilities.name: Kept Course
abilities.text: Hits for 150% MGK. 2 turns: blocks the foe's projectile moves.

abilities.name: Walked By
abilities.text: While it is out: the foe never takes two turns in a row. Can't be delayed.

abilities.name: Star Chart
abilities.text: When it comes out: 2 Fixed Stars (6% max HP), up to 3. Immune to Stun, Slow.

kinds.name: Puffball
kinds.entry: Off a field edge. Goes off when stepped on. Spores in everything, my tea as well. One cowrie, tea extra.

abilities.name: Eye Dust
abilities.text: Hits for 115% MGK. Weaken 1.

abilities.name: Plant a Cap
abilities.text: Sets a Cap, up to 3. A Cap hits the next foe out: 90% MGK, Poison 2.

abilities.name: Roll Away
abilities.text: Haste 3. It ends when a move hits it.

abilities.name: Ring of Caps
abilities.text: Sets 3 Caps on their side. Poison 2.

abilities.name: Spore Cloud
abilities.text: Its attacks add Poison 1. Its Caps deal 1.5x damage.

abilities.name: Lies Low
abilities.text: When it guards: Ward 1.

kinds.name: Hood
kinds.entry: The hood a nautilus shuts its door with. Shuts any door. Mine hasn't opened since! Writing this through the window. Four cowries.

abilities.name: Hood Knock
abilities.text: Hits for 100% ATK. Slow 1.

abilities.name: Purify
abilities.text: Heals an ally 18% of max HP. The foe takes that much as magic.

abilities.name: Hold Shut
abilities.text: Cleanses an ally. Fortify 2.

abilities.name: Shut Door
abilities.text: Your team takes no physical damage for 2 turns and heals 10%.

abilities.name: Hard Hood
abilities.text: Its attacks add 50% DEF, its moves 25% DEF.

abilities.name: Door Behind
abilities.text: When it switches out: the ally coming in gets Fortify 2.

kinds.name: Seiche
kinds.entry: Wave. Stopped on the sand, stood up gray, and has stood there since my grandfather. Four cowries. Won't move for you, either.

abilities.name: Slosh
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 78% MGK.

abilities.name: Still
abilities.text: Summons a Still Wall (25% max HP, 3 turns).

abilities.name: Hold Water
abilities.text: Hits for 110% MGK through guard.

abilities.name: Break Over
abilities.text: Wind-up. Hits every foe for 120% MGK. Stun 1. Reserves: Slow 1.

abilities.name: Standing Wave
abilities.text: Cannot be forced out. Takes 0.85x damage while its Still Wall stands.

abilities.name: Gray Pin
abilities.text: Deals 1.2x damage to a foe that can't switch.

kinds.name: Orchard
kinds.entry: An orchard's old shell, dropping fruit. Real fruit. I've eaten some. I don't ask. Four cowries, plus asking.

abilities.name: Ripe Fruit
abilities.text: Heals an ally 55% CHA + 5% of its max HP.

abilities.name: Hard Pips
abilities.text: Hits 3 times for 42% MGK.

abilities.name: Under Boughs
abilities.text: Switches to an ally. It gets Ward 1 and heals 10% of its max HP.

abilities.name: Full Bloom
abilities.text: Your team heals 20% of max HP and gets Regen 2 at 5%.

abilities.name: Last Windfall
abilities.text: When it is KO'd: the next ally out heals 20% of its max HP.

abilities.name: Too Ripe
abilities.text: When it overheals: the extra becomes a shield, up to 20% of max HP.

kinds.name: Cirrus
kinds.entry: One arm off a nautilus. Let go and kept reaching, and hasn't found anything to hold yet. Three cowries. It's been reaching for my purse.

abilities.name: Sucker Slap
abilities.text: Hits for 100% ATK. Delays the foe's next turn by 30%.

abilities.name: Cling On
abilities.text: Switches to an ally with a shield of 15% max HP + 15% CHA.

abilities.name: Long Reach
abilities.text: Drags in a reserve. Hits it for 85% ATK. Root 2.

abilities.name: Wrap Around
abilities.text: Hits for 115% ATK. Slow 2. The foe can't switch for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Suckers
abilities.text: When a foe is KO'd, and every 3rd hit: a Grip, max 10. +2% DEF and MGK each.

abilities.name: Keeps Reaching
abilities.text: Deals 1.2x damage to a Rooted foe.

kinds.name: Mawkin
kinds.entry: A scarecrow's shell, from a March. Crows still won't land near it. Two cowries, or one brave crow.

abilities.name: Straw Swipe
abilities.text: Hits for 105% MGK. Slow 1. 1.4x damage if the foe is Afraid.

abilities.name: Flap Up
abilities.text: Hits for 70% MGK, 2x if Afraid. Afraid 1: it must switch next turn.

abilities.name: Pick Clean
abilities.text: Hits for 40% MGK. Next 2 turns: hits for 35% MGK, heals 60% of it.

abilities.name: Crows Come In
abilities.text: Wind-up. Hits every foe for 75% MGK. Afraid 1. Next 2 turns: 45% MGK.

abilities.name: Looks Like One
abilities.text: When it comes out: looks like its first reserve until it acts. That move: 1.3x.

abilities.name: Scare
abilities.text: Deals 1.2x damage to a foe that is Afraid or below 40% HP.

kinds.name: Hatch
kinds.entry: And a cellar door, with an eye where the handle was. What it shuts in comes back out later. Five cowries. Knock first.

abilities.name: Swing Shut
abilities.text: Hits for 90% MGK + 6% of its max HP.

abilities.name: Below Stairs
abilities.text: Takes the foe off the field for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.text: Hits for 90% MGK + the amount its MGK beats the foe's RES.

abilities.name: Down Below
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 100% MGK + 4x the MGK it has taken.

abilities.name: Shut Air
abilities.text: Every 3rd move: 1 tide. A foe it took off the field comes back to 80% MGK.

abilities.name: Takes Weight
abilities.text: Its hits take 2 MGK from the foe and give it to Hatch, up to 20 total.

kinds.name: Kipper
kinds.entry: Fish, dried and salted on the wrack line by nobody. Who salts a fish for nobody? Very dry. One cowrie, which is more than nobody charged.

abilities.name: Kipper Slap
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 76% MGK.

abilities.name: Bubble Up
abilities.text: Heals an ally 14% of max HP. Haste 1.

abilities.name: Flip Under
abilities.text: Hidden 2. Heals 8% of its max HP.

abilities.name: Cured
abilities.text: Swallows the foe: off the field for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Hung Up
abilities.text: Its heals also remove 1 bad status.

abilities.name: Stiff
abilities.text: Its heals are 1.25x.

kinds.name: Bolide
kinds.entry: Star that came down bright at a spring low and kept burning. Not in your pocket! Four cowries, and a new pocket.

abilities.name: Cinder Flick
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 65% MGK.

abilities.name: Bright Streak
abilities.text: Short wind-up. Hits every foe for 70% MGK. Stun 1.

abilities.name: Strike Ring
abilities.text: Haste 2. Fortify 2 at 20%. Heat to 3.

abilities.name: White Line
abilities.text: Hits for 145% MGK as true damage, through guard.

abilities.name: Burning Down
abilities.text: Each move: +1 Heat, max 3. Per Heat: +6% damage, turns 5% sooner. Idle: -1.

abilities.name: Bright Fall
abilities.text: When it comes out: its first move deals 1.2x.

kinds.name: Bourdon
kinds.entry: Low note the Auger plays when air goes through it. This one kept humming, on my shelf, all night. Three cowries. Please.

abilities.name: Low Pulse
abilities.text: Hits 4 times for 28% MGK.

abilities.name: Drone Shift
abilities.text: Switches between Mend and Speed songs. Heals itself 6% of max HP.

abilities.name: Push Air
abilities.text: Hits for 60% MGK. Forces the foe out.

abilities.name: Tune Up
abilities.text: Your team gets a shield of 25% of max HP for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Amp Up
abilities.text: Every 3rd move: its next Mend heal is 2x.

abilities.name: Starts Low
abilities.text: Turns 10% sooner. Turn start: Mend song heals 4% (out ally 3%), Speed song Haste 1.

kinds.name: Cullet
kinds.entry: Off the glass desert, broken. Holds whatever it grips until both of you stop. Five cowries, handed over in gloves.

abilities.name: Glass Sliver
abilities.text: Hits for 105% MGK. 1.2x on a foe with Visions.

abilities.name: Ringing Glass
abilities.text: Hits for 80% MGK. Silence 1.

abilities.name: Glass Visions
abilities.text: Hits for 40% MGK. Visions 3: loses 5% max HP a turn.

abilities.name: Shard Grip
abilities.text: Stun 2. Hits for 60% MGK now, 45% MGK next turn. Heals 30% of it.

abilities.name: Fresh Edge
abilities.text: When it comes out: the first move to hit it deals 0.5x.

abilities.name: Broken Sharp
abilities.text: Deals 1.15x to foes with Visions. A foe KO'd with Visions passes them on.

kinds.name: Selkie
kinds.entry: What a seal-woman left on the ice. Somebody hid it in a chest once. Sleeps where it likes now. Five cowries. Don't tell her husband.

abilities.name: Undertow Mend
abilities.text: Hits for 100% MGK. Your lowest-HP whorl heals 50% of it.

abilities.name: Air Bubble
abilities.text: Wind-up. Sleep 2. Damage wakes the foe.

abilities.name: Seal Blessing
abilities.text: An ally heals 8% of max HP. 3 turns: its attacks add 30% MGK, Slow 1.

abilities.name: Seven Waves
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 115% MGK. Stun 1. Slow 2.

abilities.name: Sleepy Sea
abilities.text: When it heals an out ally: that ally's next turn comes 20% sooner.

abilities.name: Sea Born
abilities.text: Its heals are 1.25x on allies below 50% HP.

kinds.name: Heirloom
kinds.entry: Oldest whorl in the Gleaner's Tray. Nobody knows what grew in it. Takes the best thing you have. Seven cowries, then your best thing.

abilities.name: Old Dust
abilities.text: Hits for 110% MGK. Slow 2.

abilities.name: Faded Label
abilities.text: Hits for 100% MGK. Heals 30% of the damage dealt, 60% below 50% HP.

abilities.name: Nobody Knows
abilities.text: Hits for 80% MGK. 12% max HP shield. Its next turn comes 20% sooner.

abilities.name: Take to Keep
abilities.text: Hits for 80% MGK. Takes the foe's crest for the battle, in this slot.

abilities.name: Unknown Grower
abilities.text: When it uses a move: its next attack also hits reserves for 40% MGK.

abilities.name: Kept Longest
abilities.text: Immune to Silence. Cannot be forced out.

kinds.name: Cache
kinds.entry: Hole where the Mudlark hides finds. Keeps whatever falls in, people included, for a while. Three cowries. I fell in. Lost an afternoon.

abilities.name: Poke In
abilities.text: Hits for 100% MGK. 1 Sand, max 5.

abilities.name: Fall In
abilities.text: Strips shield and good statuses. Hits for 70% MGK. Slow 3. 1 Sand.

abilities.name: Shallow Hole
abilities.text: Takes the foe off the field for 1 turn. It returns with 2 Sand.

abilities.name: Keeps It
abilities.text: Hits for 60% MGK. Each foe's Sand bursts: 25% MGK, x2 per extra Sand.

abilities.name: Deep Keep
abilities.text: Takes 0.8x damage. A foe it hides comes back with 2 Sand.

abilities.name: Mudlark's Eye
abilities.text: Deals 1.25x damage to a foe with a shield or a good status.

kinds.name: Ballast
kinds.entry: Which is stones the Nautilus folk carried to sink a room. They sink on their own now. Three cowries. Weigh it before you pay, and after.

abilities.name: Drop Stone
abilities.text: Hits for 105% ATK.

abilities.name: Storm Stone
abilities.text: A Barrier on itself: 16% max HP shield, 2 turns.

abilities.name: Sink Room
abilities.text: A Barrier on an ally: 14% max HP shield, 2 turns.

abilities.name: Full Hold
abilities.text: Wind-up. Hits every foe for 100% ATK. Slow 2. Root 2. +30 Weight.

abilities.name: Sinking
abilities.text: Hits on its Barriers store Weight, max 100: +5% damage per 10. -5 a turn.

abilities.name: Ballasted
abilities.text: Cannot be forced out, dragged in, or Slowed.

kinds.name: Flotsam
kinds.entry: A crate. Floated in shut, stayed shut. I made a good offer for what's inside and it did not open. Rude. Three cowries, contents unknown.

abilities.name: Batten
abilities.text: Hits for 115% ATK. 1.3x on a foe with no reserves.

abilities.name: Stove In
abilities.text: Hits for 90% ATK. Shield of 50% of the damage + 5% max HP.

abilities.name: Bob Up
abilities.text: Drags in a reserve. Hits it for 90% ATK.

abilities.name: Nailed Shut
abilities.text: Hits for 80% ATK. 3 turns in its hold: no switch, -10% ATK, MGK, DEF.

abilities.name: Stayed Shut
abilities.text: After 3 moves in a row: for 2 turns the foe loses 4% max HP a turn.

abilities.name: Cargo
abilities.text: While the foe is in its hold: +10% ATK, MGK, and DEF.

kinds.name: Plummet
kinds.entry: The drop under the top stair. Kept falling after nobody did, and is falling now. Drop four cowries in and listen for them.

abilities.name: Drop In
abilities.text: Hits for 100% MGK. Its next turn comes 20% sooner.

abilities.name: Freefall
abilities.text: Hits for 30% MGK. The foe falls off the field for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Trip
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 75% MGK. Slow 1.

abilities.name: Bottom Out
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 90% MGK. Haste 2. 3 turns: 1.15x MGK and AGI.

abilities.name: Kept Falling
abilities.text: After Bottom Out, for 3 turns: takes 0.85x damage, moves deal 1.2x.

abilities.name: No Floor
abilities.text: A foe it drops off the field comes back to 30% MGK.

kinds.name: Eddy
kinds.entry: Off a river bend. Turns in one place and makes you turn. Three cowries. I went dizzy counting them.

abilities.name: Dizzy Wave
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 60% MGK. Expose 1.

abilities.name: Spin Bolt
abilities.text: Hits for 100% MGK. Stun 1.

abilities.name: Hand Round

abilities.text: Hits for 110% MGK. Expose 1.

abilities.name: Gnash Bite
abilities.text: Hits for 105% ATK. Bleed 2 at 12% ATK.

abilities.name: All Teeth

abilities.name: Eel Coil
abilities.text: Hits every foe for 75% ATK. Stun 1.

abilities.name: Slick
abilities.text: Third Bite heals it 6% of its max HP.
